notes.title: Version 2
notes.content:
Cube skins – unlock new looks with collected points
Points system – you now earn points for completing a level
Retro bonus – everyone who has already passed levels receives points automatically
Optimizations and improvements – smoother experience, faster loading
Added store for selecting and purchasing skins
